subtitle.zh: 把推理服务变成可运维的工作负载

description.zh: 从 Pod 与资源请求到 GPU 调度、模型存储、健康检查与发布回滚，完成一份可复用的 AI 服务部署方案。
description.en: Move from Pods and resource requests to GPU scheduling, model storage, health checks and rollbacks. Produce a reusable AI service deployment plan.

prerequisites.zh: 理解 Linux、容器镜像、HTTP；建议先完成基础与 vLLM 路线。
prerequisites.en: Linux, container images and HTTP; foundations and vLLM are recommended first.

hardware.zh: 普通电脑可用 kind 完成控制面实验；真实 GPU 调度需兼容节点、驱动与设备插件。
hardware.en: A laptop with kind is enough for control-plane labs. Actual GPU scheduling needs compatible nodes, drivers and device plugins.

zh: AI 平台工程师
MLOps 工程师
推理 SRE
en: AI platform engineer
MLOps engineer
Inference SRE

outcome.zh: 一套含部署、探针、存储、扩缩容决策与故障演练记录的推理服务清单。
outcome.en: An inference deployment bundle with probes, storage, scaling decisions and incident drill records.

resources.title: Kubernetes · Startup, readiness and liveness probes

title.zh: 建立实验集群与对象地图
title.en: Create a lab cluster and object map

lesson.zh: Kubernetes 通过控制循环让实际状态逐步接近期望状态。Pod 是调度的基本单位，Deployment 管理副本与更新，Service 提供稳定访问入口。控制面只知道资源与声明，并不理解模型效果。先把这些责任区分开，才能解释“进程在运行”与“推理服务可用”之间的差距。所有动手操作使用自己创建的实验集群。
lesson.en: Kubernetes controllers reconcile observed state toward declared state. A Pod is a scheduling unit; a Deployment manages replicas and updates; a Service provides a stable access endpoint. The control plane understands resources and declarations, not model quality. Separate these responsibilities before interpreting a running process as a usable inference service. Use a lab cluster you own for every exercise.

task.zh: 按 kind 官方指南创建 jobhub-lab 集群，部署一个轻量 HTTP 示例，画出请求从 Service 到 Pod 的路径。保存 kubectl 与集群版本。
task.en: Create a jobhub-lab cluster using the kind guide, deploy a small HTTP example and map the Service-to-Pod request path. Record kubectl and cluster versions.

evidence.zh: 对象关系图、环境记录与最小 Deployment/Service 清单。
evidence.en: An object diagram, environment record and minimal Deployment/Service manifests.

zh: 能解释 Pod、Deployment、Service 的不同职责
能从集群内访问示例，或准确说明运行条件缺口
en: Explain the separate responsibilities of Pod, Deployment and Service
Reach the example inside the cluster, or document the missing execution prerequisites

noGpu.zh: 本日不需要 GPU；没有容器环境时完成清单评审与对象生命周期图。
noGpu.en: No GPU is needed. Without a container runtime, review the manifests and draw the object lifecycle.

lesson.zh: CPU 和内存的 requests 影响调度，limits 约束容器可用资源，但两者不是同一种承诺。模型权重、KV cache、运行时缓冲与主机内存都可能成为瓶颈；只看 GPU 数量会漏掉 CPU 数据处理和内存压力。调度可容纳并不意味着延迟目标已达成，容量预算与性能验收需要分别记录。
lesson.en: CPU and memory requests inform scheduling, while limits constrain resource use. They are different contracts. Weights, KV cache, runtime buffers and host memory can each become bottlenecks; GPU counts alone miss CPU preprocessing and host pressure. A schedulable workload has not necessarily met its latency objective. Keep capacity planning and performance acceptance as separate records.

task.zh: 为示例服务设置 requests/limits，观察 Pod 的调度事件。再为一个选定模型编写 CPU、主机内存、GPU 显存与并发预算，说明每项依据。
task.en: Set requests and limits for the sample service and inspect scheduling events. Draft CPU, host-memory, GPU-memory and concurrency budgets for one model, explaining each assumption.

evidence.zh: 资源预算表与一次可解释的 Pending 或资源限制观察。
evidence.en: A resource budget and one explained scheduling or resource-limit observation.

zh: 区分 requests 与 limits
预算包含权重、KV cache 与非模型开销
en: Distinguish requests from limits
Account for weights, KV cache and non-model overhead

noGpu.zh: 用 CPU 服务观察调度；模型显存项写为估算，标注未实测。
noGpu.en: Observe scheduling with a CPU service; label model-memory values as estimates.

title.zh: 理解 GPU 是如何被调度的

lesson.zh: 设备插件把厂商设备暴露为扩展资源，调度器根据资源请求选择节点。申请 GPU 不会替你安装驱动，也不会自动保证镜像、CUDA 与引擎兼容。标签和亲和性可以表达硬件约束，但不能凭空创建资源。学习 GPU 调度的关键是把发现、分配、运行时访问与应用可用这四个阶段分别验证。
lesson.en: Device plugins expose vendor devices as extended resources; the scheduler selects nodes that satisfy requests. A GPU request does not install drivers or guarantee image, CUDA and engine compatibility. Labels and affinity express constraints but cannot create capacity. Verify discovery, allocation, runtime access and application readiness separately rather than treating scheduling as the whole GPU integration.

task.zh: 阅读设备插件与 GPU 调度文档，编写一个明确 GPU 资源名的 Pod 清单；有 GPU 的实验节点验证设备可见性，无 GPU 时解释 Pending 的事件原因。
task.en: Read device-plugin and GPU-scheduling guidance. Write a manifest with an explicit GPU resource name. Validate device visibility on a GPU lab node, or explain Pending events without one.

evidence.zh: GPU 依赖矩阵、Pod 清单与调度链路说明。
evidence.en: A GPU dependency matrix, Pod manifest and scheduling walkthrough.

zh: 说明资源名来自哪种设备插件
不把 kind 中的普通节点称为真实 GPU 环境
en: Identify the device plugin behind the resource name
Do not describe ordinary kind nodes as a real GPU setup

noGpu.zh: 在无 GPU 集群中审查资源声明，记录预期不可调度原因；不伪造设备成功日志。
noGpu.en: Review the resource declaration and expected unschedulable state; do not fabricate device-success logs.

title.zh: 模型文件与数据生命周期
title.en: Manage model files and their lifecycle

lesson.zh: 容器镜像、模型文件和运行时缓存有不同更新节奏。把大权重塞进每个镜像会增加分发负担；把下载放在启动路径又可能延长冷启动。持久卷声明表达存储需求，实际后端决定访问模式和性能。讨论共享目录时还应考虑版本固定、并发读取与权限，而不是只比较磁盘容量。
lesson.en: Images, model files and runtime caches change on different schedules. Baking large weights into every image increases distribution cost; downloading during startup extends cold starts. A persistent-volume claim declares storage needs while its backend determines access modes and performance. Shared model storage also needs version pinning, concurrent-read planning and permissions, not just a capacity comparison.

task.zh: 用小型测试文件验证卷挂载和 Pod 重建后的行为，设计模型 revision 与校验记录。比较镜像内置、启动下载和共享模型卷三种路径。
task.en: Use a small file to verify mounts and behavior after Pod replacement. Design model-revision and checksum records. Compare image-bundled, startup-download and shared-volume approaches.

evidence.zh: 存储决策表、挂载清单与冷启动路径图。
evidence.en: A storage decision table, mount manifest and cold-start diagram.

zh: 说明卷的访问模式与生命周期
把模型版本与可变缓存区分开
en: Explain volume access modes and lifecycle
Separate model versions from mutable caches

noGpu.zh: 用 KB 级文件替代真实模型权重，验证的是存储语义。
noGpu.en: Use kilobyte-sized files instead of weights; validate storage semantics only.

title.zh: 让探针反映真实服务状态

lesson.zh: startup、readiness 与 liveness 分别回答启动是否完成、是否应接收流量、是否需要重启。大模型加载慢时，激进的存活探针可能反复杀掉本来正常的进程；readiness 也不应在每次检查都执行昂贵推理。探针设计应连接模型加载、路由准入和恢复策略，而不是复制普通网页的超时值。
lesson.en: Startup, readiness and liveness probes answer different questions: has initialization finished, should traffic arrive, and should the process restart? Aggressive liveness checks can repeatedly kill a healthy model-loading process. Readiness checks should not perform expensive inference on every probe. Connect checks to model initialization, traffic admission and recovery rather than copying generic web-server timeouts.

task.zh: 用可配置启动延迟的轻量服务模拟模型加载，分别配置三类探针，观察 Ready 状态、端点变化与重启计数。
task.en: Simulate model loading with a lightweight service that has a configurable startup delay. Configure the three probe types and observe readiness, endpoints and restart counts.

evidence.zh: 探针清单与正常启动、暂不可用、进程卡住三种时序图。
evidence.en: Probe manifests and timelines for startup, temporary unavailability and a stuck process.

zh: 区分停止路由与重启进程
启动容忍时间有测量或明确假设
en: Distinguish traffic removal from process restart
Justify startup tolerance with measurements or stated assumptions

noGpu.zh: 用 CPU HTTP 服务模拟状态转换，不需要加载大模型。
noGpu.en: Use a CPU HTTP service to simulate state transitions.

reading.title: Kubernetes · Startup, readiness and liveness probes

lesson.zh: Service 将访问地址与具体 Pod 解耦，但它不自动提供身份验证或流量控制。内部服务、外部入口和管理接口应分别设计。NetworkPolicy 的执行依赖网络插件；写了策略文件不等于隔离已经生效。对 AI 服务还要辨别普通请求、流式响应和长连接在代理超时上的差异。
lesson.en: A Service decouples an endpoint from individual Pods; it does not provide authentication or traffic control automatically. Design internal serving, external entry points and administrative access separately. NetworkPolicy enforcement depends on the network plugin, so a policy file is not proof of isolation. AI endpoints also need deliberate treatment of streaming responses and long-lived connections at proxy timeouts.

task.zh: 画出客户端、入口、服务和模型进程的边界；在实验集群里用 ClusterIP 或 port-forward 验证访问，编写允许必要流量的策略评审说明。
task.en: Map client, entry point, Service and model-process boundaries. Verify lab access with ClusterIP or port-forward and review a policy allowing necessary traffic.

evidence.zh: 访问路径图、测试记录与边界说明。
evidence.en: An access diagram, test record and boundary description.

zh: 识别访问控制应由哪一层实现
声明网络插件是否支持所写策略
en: Identify which layer provides access control
State whether the network plugin enforces the proposed policy

noGpu.zh: 用轻量回显服务练习网络路径，并注明没有真实推理流量。
noGpu.en: Use a lightweight echo service and label the traffic as a network exercise.

lesson.zh: 增加副本前必须先确认瓶颈在哪里。GPU 利用率、排队长度、并发和尾延迟各自描述不同状态，不能互相替代。HPA 依赖可获得的指标及其适配组件；模型加载与权重分发会让扩容存在明显延迟。好的策略也应限制抖动，并考虑缩容时仍在生成的请求。
lesson.en: Before adding replicas, identify the bottleneck. GPU utilization, queue length, concurrency and tail latency describe different conditions. HPA depends on available metrics and their adapters; model initialization and weight distribution can make scaling slow. A useful policy also limits oscillation and addresses requests still generating during scale-down. More replicas are not an automatic latency fix.

task.zh: 为一个假设工作负载选主指标与辅助指标，写扩缩容决策表；有 metrics-server 时用 CPU 服务演示 HPA，没有时手工推演负载时间线。
task.en: Choose primary and supporting signals for a workload and write a scaling decision table. Demonstrate HPA on a CPU service if metrics-server is available; otherwise simulate a load timeline manually.

evidence.zh: 扩缩容设计、指标来源与一次负载变化分析。
evidence.en: A scaling design, metric sources and one load-change analysis.

zh: 指标确实可被当前集群获取或标明缺口
考虑启动延迟、冷却时间与正在处理的请求
en: Identify available metrics and missing integrations
Account for initialization delay, stabilization and in-flight requests

noGpu.zh: CPU HPA 仅验证控制流程，不拿它证明 GPU 推理扩容效果。
noGpu.en: Use CPU HPA to validate the control loop, not GPU-serving performance.

title.zh: 滚动发布与可回滚版本
title.en: Roll out and roll back predictably

lesson.zh: 应用版本、模型 revision 与配置共同决定服务行为。Deployment 的滚动更新管理副本替换，但副本临时增加可能超出稀缺 GPU 配额；新版本 Ready 也不等于质量和性能合格。发布计划应把兼容性检查、流量切换、结果对照与回滚触发条件连在一起。
lesson.en: Application version, model revision and configuration together determine behavior. A Deployment manages replica replacement, but temporary extra replicas can exceed scarce GPU capacity. Ready status alone does not prove acceptable quality or performance. A release plan should connect compatibility checks, traffic movement, result comparison and explicit rollback triggers.

task.zh: 对 CPU 示例服务发布两个明确版本，观察滚动更新并执行回滚；为 GPU 版本写出 maxSurge、容量和模型兼容性的取舍。
task.en: Roll out two explicit versions of the CPU example and execute a rollback. Explain capacity, maxSurge and model-compatibility trade-offs for a GPU deployment.

evidence.zh: 版本清单、回滚操作记录与发布准入条件。
evidence.en: Version records, a rollback log and release acceptance criteria.

zh: 可以说明当前运行的是哪个镜像与配置
回滚触发条件可被观察和判断
en: Identify the running image and configuration
Define observable rollback triggers

noGpu.zh: CPU 实验完成发布机制验证，GPU 容量以设计假设表达。
noGpu.en: Validate release mechanics with CPU workloads and label GPU capacity assumptions.

lesson.zh: 一个失败请求可能来自调度、镜像拉取、模型加载、资源不足、路由或应用本身。事件、容器日志与服务指标观察的是不同层面。先保留时间线并缩小故障范围，再修改配置，能避免把偶然恢复误认为修复。故障演练的价值在于可重复地触发与解释，而不是制造复杂故障。
lesson.en: A failed request may originate in scheduling, image pulls, model initialization, resource pressure, routing or the application. Events, container logs and service metrics cover different layers. Preserve a timeline and narrow the failure before changing configuration, so accidental recovery is not mistaken for a fix. A useful drill is repeatable and explainable rather than elaborate.

task.zh: 在自己的实验集群制造一种可恢复错误，例如错误端口或不可满足的资源请求；用 get、describe、logs 收集证据，再只改一个变量修复。
task.en: Introduce one recoverable error in your lab, such as a wrong port or unsatisfiable request. Collect evidence with get, describe and logs, then change one variable to repair it.

evidence.zh: 一页故障复盘：现象、时间线、根因、修复与验证。
evidence.en: A one-page incident report with symptoms, timeline, cause, repair and verification.

zh: 保存修复前的原始观察
修复后重复同一检查证明恢复
en: Preserve observations from before the repair
Repeat the same check after the repair

noGpu.zh: 整个演练可用 CPU 服务完成，不需要 GPU。
noGpu.en: Run the entire drill with a CPU service.

reading.title: Kubernetes · Startup, readiness and liveness probes

title.zh: 交付一套可评审的 AI 平台方案
title.en: Deliver a reviewable AI platform bundle

lesson.zh: 结课作品应让另一位工程师能够理解并复现你的选择。把部署、资源、模型版本、访问边界、扩缩容和故障记录放在同一仓库，分清已在 CPU 环境验证的机制、GPU 实测结果与尚待验证的设计。平台工程能力体现在约束与失败路径的处理，也体现在默认值是否清楚。
lesson.en: Your final project should let another engineer understand and reproduce your decisions. Keep deployment, resources, model versions, access boundaries, scaling and incident records together. Distinguish mechanisms validated on CPU, real GPU measurements and untested design. Platform skill includes handling constraints and failure paths, as well as making defaults understandable.

task.zh: 整理一套按顺序可执行的部署/验证/清理说明，请同伴按 README 评审。写出三项后续工作，链接作品到个人公开仓库。
task.en: Assemble deployment, verification and cleanup instructions. Ask a peer to review the README. Record three follow-up tasks and publish the portfolio repository if desired.

evidence.zh: 包含清单、架构图、版本表、运维手册与验证边界的作品仓库。
evidence.en: A portfolio repository with manifests, diagrams, versions, a runbook and validation boundaries.

zh: 没有把未运行的 GPU 实验写成成功
清理操作只针对明确创建的实验资源
说明与 vLLM、Ray 或 Dynamo 的下一步连接
en: Do not report unrun GPU experiments as successful
Scope cleanup to explicitly created lab resources
Explain the next connection to vLLM, Ray or Dynamo

noGpu.zh: 交付完整 CPU 控制面实验与 GPU 部署设计；将两类证据分开。
noGpu.en: Deliver CPU control-plane experiments and a separate GPU deployment design.
